access_boundary: This record represents the o4-mini release identified by the dated snapshot o4-mini-2025-04-16, announced April 2025. OpenAI announced its deprecation and documents the shutdown date of October 23, 2026 with GPT-5.6 Terra as the recommended replacement. The o1 and o3 lines, the later GPT-5 family, the OpenAI platform, and ChatGPT remain separate product or service boundaries.
strengths: OpenAI documents the pinned snapshot, deprecation date, and recommended replacement first-party
Reasoning behavior, image input, tool use, and structured outputs are documented
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation
Access ends at the documented shutdown date

evidence.label: Official API deprecations and model lifecycle page

flags.statement: OpenAI’s Safety Advisory Group (SAG) reviewed the results of our Preparedness evaluations and determined that OpenAI o3 and o4-mini do not reach the High threshold in any of our three Tracked Categories: Biological and Chemical Capability, Cybersecurity, and AI Self-improvement.
